newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares becalmed on pre-holiday market.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares becalmed on pre-holiday market.

text.p: Danish share prices were virtually unchanged at mid-morning Wednesday, with the usual boosting effect of gains on Wall Street reduced by SAS losses.
At 0940 GMT the KFX top-20 index was up 0.01 point, at 160.05 and its June future was 0.20 point higher, at 159.90.
SAS damped the index with a five percent fall after surprising analysts after closing time on Tuesday with an announcement of unexpected first quarter losses.
